name: Medical Team
description: Designs and delivers CIG's peer teaching programme — anatomy and physiology sessions, ECG workshops, exam-focused revision and the written teaching resources on this platform.

name: Social Media Team
description: Owns CIG's visual identity and voice: design, photography, social media, the newsletter and this platform's content presentation.

name: Affairs Team
description: Plans and runs CIG's calendar — symposia, guest lectures, skills workshops, conference participation and the group's flagship annual event.

name: Research Team
description: Supports students through the research process: question design, literature review, ethics and approvals, data handling, abstract writing and presentation.

name: Journal Team
description: Manages the publication and dissemination of CIG's research and academic content.

name: Planning Team
description: Oversees the strategic planning and coordination of CIG's activities and initiatives.

name: FRC Team
description: Oversees CIG's financial planning, budgeting, and sponsorship management while coordinating research grants and faculty relations to keep all group initiatives fully funded.
